title: ProductCreationPublication
description: Cloud publication of a Product to hosted discovery, performed only after canonical daemon creation succeeds. Non-canonical directory metadata. Idempotent by canonical product_id + idempotency_key; retrying a failed publication never creates a second Product. See docs/specs/domain-product-onboarding-contract.md.

product_id.description: Canonical Product id from the daemon's ProductCreationResult. Cloud never invents this.

creator_cloud_account_id.description: Signed equality claim binding this publication to the authenticated creator Cloud account from the daemon's ProductCreationResult. Never the full hosted (Supabase) session token, a refresh token, or any provider secret.

canonical.description: Always false. A published directory row is explicitly non-canonical.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key; publish retries with the same key + product_id update the existing row rather than creating a second Product.

canonical_creation_receipt_ref.description: Reference to the daemon's canonical creation receipt this publication is derived from.
